metrics.label: Passer rating
metrics.formula: (CASE WHEN (pass_cmp / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) - 0.3) * 5 < 0 THEN 0 WHEN (pass_cmp / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) - 0.3) * 5 > 2.375 THEN 2.375 ELSE (pass_cmp / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) - 0.3) * 5 END + CASE WHEN (pass_yards / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) - 3) * 0.25 < 0 THEN 0 WHEN (pass_yards / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) - 3) * 0.25 > 2.375 THEN 2.375 ELSE (pass_yards / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) - 3) * 0.25 END + CASE WHEN pass_tds / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) * 20 < 0 THEN 0 WHEN pass_tds / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) * 20 > 2.375 THEN 2.375 ELSE pass_tds / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) * 20 END + CASE WHEN 2.375 - pass_int / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) * 25 < 0 THEN 0 WHEN 2.375 - pass_int / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) * 25 > 2.375 THEN 2.375 ELSE 2.375 - pass_int / NULLIF(pass_att, 0) * 25 END) / 6 * 100
metrics.help: The NFL passer rating from attempts, completions, yards, touchdowns and interceptions (each part held between 0 and 2.375).

reference_values.source: nflverse player stats (player_game.parquet), regular season totals (NFL formula; 92.6 published)

metrics.label: Fantasy pts (standard)
metrics.formula: 0.04 * pass_yards + 4 * pass_tds - 2 * pass_int + 0.1 * (rush_yards + rec_yards) + 6 * (rush_tds + rec_tds) - 2 * (fum_rush + fum_rec + fum_sack)
metrics.help: Fantasy points under standard scoring: 0.04 a passing yard, 4 a passing TD, -2 an interception, 0.1 a rushing or receiving yard, 6 a rushing or receiving TD, 0 a reception, -2 a fumble lost. Two-point conversions are not counted (not in the stat data).

reference_values.source: nflverse weekly player stats (data/raw/nfl_player_stats.parquet), regular season

metrics.label: Fantasy pts (half PPR)
metrics.formula: 0.04 * pass_yards + 4 * pass_tds - 2 * pass_int + 0.1 * (rush_yards + rec_yards) + 6 * (rush_tds + rec_tds) - 2 * (fum_rush + fum_rec + fum_sack) + 0.5 * rec_receptions
metrics.help: Fantasy points under half PPR scoring: 0.04 a passing yard, 4 a passing TD, -2 an interception, 0.1 a rushing or receiving yard, 6 a rushing or receiving TD, 0.5 a reception, -2 a fumble lost. Two-point conversions are not counted (not in the stat data).

reference_values.source: nflverse weekly player stats (data/raw/nfl_player_stats.parquet), regular season (mean of standard and PPR)

metrics.label: Fantasy pts (PPR)
metrics.formula: 0.04 * pass_yards + 4 * pass_tds - 2 * pass_int + 0.1 * (rush_yards + rec_yards) + 6 * (rush_tds + rec_tds) - 2 * (fum_rush + fum_rec + fum_sack) + rec_receptions
metrics.help: Fantasy points under full PPR scoring: 0.04 a passing yard, 4 a passing TD, -2 an interception, 0.1 a rushing or receiving yard, 6 a rushing or receiving TD, 1 a reception, -2 a fumble lost. Two-point conversions are not counted (not in the stat data).
